label: US-12CFR1002-RegB-1977 Supplement I, Section 1002.104—Covered Credit Transactions and Excluded Transactions

obligations.text: A financial institution shall report an extension of business credit incident to a factoring arrangement that is otherwise a covered credit transaction as “Other” under § 1002.107(a)(5).
The base for computing each adjustment is the January 2030 CPI-U; this base value shall be compared to the CPI-U value in January 2035 and every five years thereafter.

If publication of the CPI-U ceases, or if the CPI-U otherwise becomes unavailable or is altered in such a way as to be unusable, then the Bureau shall substitute another reliable cost of living indicator from the United States Government for the purpose of calculating adjustments pursuant to § 1002.104(b)(9)(ii).
